Model exposes matrix_levels/matrix_approvers/current_approval_level/approval_history. submit-for-review accepts empty approver_email when a matrix exists and only L1 approvers get emailed initially; approve advances through levels (L1→L2→approved). (2) Frontend notification bell inline actions — Approve UI works correctly (textarea shows 'Optional comment', Confirm Approve button not disabled). ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the Reject button sets expandedActionId = `reject-${notif.id}` but the render condition on line 447 uses strict equality: `isExpanded = expandedActionId === notif.id`. As a result, the textarea + Confirm Reject panel never appears, and the Approve/Reject/Open buttons remain visible. Only Approve currently expands the comment panel. Reject-with-reason flow is fully broken in the notification bell.

issues: React hydration warnings in console: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <tbody>' and '<tr> cannot be a child of <span>'. A veDynamic wrapper <span style={display:contents}> is being rendered inside <tbody> and around <tr>, which is invalid HTML. Not visible to users but pollutes console and can break SSR.

action_items: Fix Layout.js line 447: change `const isExpanded = expandedActionId === notif.id;` to `const isExpanded = expandedActionId === notif.id || expandedActionId === `reject-${notif.id}`;` so the Reject action expands the comment textarea. Without this fix, the inline Reject-from-bell flow is unusable — placeholder 'Reason for rejection (required)' and Confirm Reject button are never rendered.
(Nice-to-have) Investigate and remove the veDynamic <span style={display:contents}> wrapper around Sales Manager Leaderboard <tr> rows on the Dashboard to eliminate invalid-HTML hydration warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js:447 — isExpanded strict-equality check misses the 'reject-<id>' prefix used by the Reject button's setExpandedActionId call. Rewrite to accept either form (or better, store `{ id, mode }` as state instead of a stringly-typed 'reject-<id>' key).

projects.py submit_for_review: dedup on approver emails uses .lower() but matrix_levels stores emails as-is; downstream comparisons should also lowercase. Currently OK because the L1 fan-out uses lowercased emails from matrix_approvers, but any custom approver_email supplied by user is NOT lowercased before being stored in project.approver_email, which could break later access checks that compare against user.email.

rca_of_the_issue: In frontend/src/components/Layout.js the notification quick-action panel supports two modes: 'approve' (expandedActionId = notif.id) and 'reject' (expandedActionId = `reject-${notif.id}`). However line 447 computes `isExpanded = expandedActionId === notif.id`, which is true only for the approve case. When Reject is clicked, expandedActionId becomes 'reject-<id>' but isExpanded stays false, so the textarea + Confirm buttons block (guarded by `{!isExpanded ? <buttons> : <panel>}`) never renders. The placeholder and disabled-when-empty logic inside that block are correct — they just never mount for the reject flow. Fix: broaden the isExpanded check or refactor state to `{ id, mode }` and compare mode explicitly.
